acceptance: Freeze the sample and request contract before fetching or examining price outcomes.
Keep the API's inclusive bounds distinct from the local half-open interval; preserve exact timestamp and numeric text before normalization.
Use explicit feed, adjustment, currency, symbol-asof and ordering; retain and validate a terminal pagination chain, not merely the first page or SDK total cap.
Bind plan, collector, SDK sources, complete response bytes and derived outputs by hashes; refuse overwrite, truncation, cycles, duplicate identities and out-of-range rows.
No silent IEX downgrade, credential retry loop or access-refusal bypass. A refused corporate-action endpoint does not invalidate a separately accepted bar acquisition.
Current API observations, symbol-asof mapping and retrospective adjustment do not establish original historical information availability or an all-equities universe.
Keep native SDK transport and custom provenance/validation behavior identified separately, including pinned private seams needed for response capture and bounded retries.
Record useful failures and limits. Independently review code/evidence and complete appropriate local checks before GitHub publication.
continuation: After this sample, define an entitled historical universe and source-revision policy before broader mover/catalyst sampling or strategy evaluation. Paper execution remains deferred.

results.unresolved: Dividend currency missing; original historical availability/universe, strategy evaluation, macOS/off-host operations and causal whole-task token savings remain gated.
